quests.name: The Giant Rats
quests.description: Get rid of those giant rats in their giant rat hiole

steps.name: Step 1 Kill the Cave Rats
steps.description: Kill the Giant Rats in the cave under the shop

steps.name: Step 2: Kill the Basement Rats!!!
steps.description: Kill the rats inthe basement too!!!!!

steps.name: Step 3: Deal with the rats around Hallowmere
Step 4: Clear the goblins hiding in a town house
steps.description: Goblins have been seen slipping into one of Hollowmere's houses after dark. Search the town houses and drive them out.

quest_giver.start_dialog: I'm the owner of the General Shop and my basement is infested with Giant Rats. Can you take care of this problem for me? I fear that the infestation is spreading and I blame those goblins that have been sneaking around.
quest_giver.end_dialog: Thank you so much for getting rid of those rats and dealing with that cave system... Who knew?

quests.name: Chase the Goblins Away
quests.description: The town has learned that the Giant Rat infestation started with the goblins in their grotto just north of town. We suspect they have been burrowing into town, probably near the general shop. Go and chase them out!

steps.name: Remove the Goblin Squatters from the Grotto
Return the Chest
steps.description: The goblins have  taken the town treasury! Find it and return it to the mayor.

quest_giver.start_dialog: The town has learned that the Giant Rat infestation started with the goblins in their grotto just north of town. We suspect they have been burrowing into town, probably near the general shop. Go and chase them out!
quest_giver.end_dialog: Thank you brave traveler. I assumed you would have returned, dead and floating by town but you have prevailed! You have the town's thanks!.

quests.name: Explore the Grotto
quests.description: There is another grotto just north of the goblins, explore that and make sure it does not pose a menace to Hallowmere

quest_giver.start_dialog: There is another grotto just north of the goblins, explore that and make sure it does not pose a menace to Hallowmere
quest_giver.end_dialog: Looks like my suspicion was correct, please accept the thanks of the people of Hallowmere

quest_giver.start_dialog: I have heard that there is a forest just north of us with great treasure lurking in the shadows. Can you help map out the dark forest?
quest_giver.end_dialog: This is amazing, I had no idea how far the forest reached. You will be rewarded.

quest_giver.start_dialog: What's happening with these pirate raids? And in Hallowmere of all places. My entire troop was robbed by pirates right over there in that lake! I don't know where they are coming from, but I suspect it's that unsavory inn.
quest_giver.end_dialog: You are my true hero, I will somersault back to my place and get the rest my troop. The town owes you a debt, but that's not something I can pay out. bye bye!

quests.name: Wolves on the Tradeway
quests.description: The packs squatting on the road south of Varnfell aren't hunting deer — they're holding the road. Break them so the sledges can run again.

steps.name: Drive the wolf packs off the tradeway
steps.description: Hunt down the wolf packs lairing in the snowfields around Varnfell.

quest_giver.start_dialog: Twenty years trapping this country and I've never seen wolves hold a road like soldiers. Two packs, dug in on the tradeway, and every sledge in Varnfell stuck behind them. Clear them out and Sela can move her ledgers from red ink back to black.
quest_giver.end_dialog: Both packs broken — and you walked back out, which is better than the last three who tried. The tradeway's open. First sledge south carries word that Varnfell's still in business, and that's your doing.

quests.name: The Drowned Cargo
quests.description: A trade-sealed crate has washed up on the sand south of Varnfell. Sela Varn wants it back before the sea — or whatever paces the shore at night — takes it first.

steps.name: Recover the crate from the southern shore
steps.description: Find the trade-sealed crate Maro spotted on the sand south of town and bring it back. Something has been pacing that stretch of shore at night.

quest_giver.start_dialog: Maro logged a crate on the south sand — trade-sealed, which means it was bound for this post, which means it's mine. I'd send someone, but everyone I'd send is either behind this counter or buried. Bring it back whole and Varn and Daughters will remember you in the ledger, the good column.
quest_giver.end_dialog: The seal's my grandmother's mark — this crate left here forty years ago and the sea's only now giving it back. I don't know whether to thank you or apologize to you. Take this and we'll call it both.

quests.name: Into the Frost Delve
quests.description: The abandoned digging south of Varnfell has started breathing warm air. Henna Stone wants to know what's moved in below before it decides to move up.

steps.name: Explore the Frost Delve
steps.description: Descend the old workings and find the source of the warm air.

quest_giver.start_dialog: That delve was dead cold for nine years while I worked it, and dead quiet for twenty after. Now it breathes warm and the snow won't settle on the ridge. Go down, both levels, all the way to the warm dark — and come back and tell an old miner what's woken up under her town.
quest_giver.end_dialog: So the cracks do keep going down. I knew it — knew it when the company packed up, knew it every warm night since. You've bought Varnfell something nobody's had up here in a long while: warning. The town owes you, and so do I.
